message.reasoning:
I need $62 more to cover the shortfall, so I'm looking for a mortgage option that covers it without too much strategic damage. I've got my green monopoly (Pacific, NC, Penn) fully built, plus a lone yellow and orange property, so I'm weighing which single property to mortgage to raise the cash while keeping my strongest set intact.

Mortgaging St James for $90 covers the shortfall cleanly, and since I don't have the full orange set, giving it up costs me little strategically—it even denies another player their orange monopoly. I'll keep Atlantic since it could complete a yellow set later, and obviously keep the greens untouched.
